s.how: Tear a loaf of crusty bread into thick chunks and pile onto a big wooden board. Add wedges of aged cheddar, a bowl of pickled onions and green apple wedges. Set it in the middle of the table like a lord's supper in a draughty castle hall.

Toss 100g each of walnuts, hazelnuts and almonds with 3 tbsp honey and a pinch of cinnamon. Spread on a lined tray and roast at 170C for 15 minutes, stirring once. Cool completely so they set, then break into clusters for little paws.

m.note: the New Year's tournament in London
m.how: Brown 1kg diced beef chuck with 2 sliced onions. Add 375ml brown ale and water to cover and simmer for 3 hours. Thicken, spoon into a dish and top with puff pastry. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Serve with buttery mash and peas.

w.how: Rub 100g butter into 300g self-raising flour, then add enough milk to make a soft dough. Roll into a rectangle, spread with raspberry jam and roll up. Wrap loosely in baking paper and bake at 180C for 40 minutes. Slice and pour over hot custard.

d.n: Merlin's spiced milk tea and sugar cubes
d.note: Merlin's sugar bowl that walks itself to the cup
d.how: Bring 500ml water to the boil with 2 cinnamon sticks, 6 crushed cardamom pods and 5 slices fresh ginger and simmer 5 minutes. Add 4 black tea bags and 500ml full cream milk and bring back to a gentle simmer for 3 minutes. Strain into 4 cups and serve with a bowl of sugar cubes on the side.
